admission.justification: Assuming every provider suppresses the ambient server would let an agent call the wrong product installation.

applicability: Role agents started through pinned Paseo0.11.1, by the per-launch exclusion record.
conditions: Claude applies the exact other-product tool exclusion.
Codex, Hermes/ACP and Pi retain the explicitly ruled per-provider exception and truthfully report the other copy.
exclusions: Agents not started by the product.
A future host/provider mechanism requires fresh source proof and native-record qualification.
statement: A Claude role agent started through the host does not carry the tools of the server `agents-remember`; a Codex, Hermes or Pi role agent carries them where its own configuration names that server, and the start says so.
